part: Alpha 9 mm vertical potentiometer (RV09AF-40 / RV09BF-40 and bushing variants)
notes: GENUINE Taiwan Alpha datasheet '9mm Rotary Type, Snap-In, Insulated Shaft' (RV09 series), 7 sheets + Mouser cover. Filed under RV09AF-40 because that is the vertical single-gang variant, but the file covers the whole 9 mm family. BODY WIDTH 9.8 mm; overall width across the two snap-in lugs 11.4 mm; 5.5 mm from shaft axis to the lower body face; mounting height (board to shaft axis) 7.0 mm for all -40 vertical variants, 10.0 mm for -20, 6.5 mm for -21. PCB pattern: 3 x D1.0 +0.2/-0 pins on 5.0 mm total span (2.5 mm pitch), two 2.1 x 1.8 snap-in slots 10.6 mm apart, 7.0 mm offset. Shaft D6.0 0/-0.1, 40-tooth knurl or D-flat or round, C0.5 chamfer. Bushing: the plain -40 has NO bushing (snap-in only); the E1 suffix is a METAL M9 x 0.75 bushing and E1N a plastic D9 bushing. CENTRE DETENT = order-code suffix 0C ('with center click'), click torque 20-120 gf.cm, rotation life 5000 cycles with click vs 10000 without. Tapers A (log), B (linear), C (rev-log), 1 k to 500 k and 1 M. Rotational angle 280+/-5 deg (RV09A) or 300+/-5 deg (RV09B).

GENUINE E-Switch production drawing ST110004 Rev A (11/1/05) for 100SP1T2B3M2QEH + Mouser cover.
